text.text_excerpt: I was lucky enough to stay at Aloft hotel about a month after they first opened for business. They're still slowly completing different sections for the hotel, but the construction is not noisy, the staff are constantly cleaning so it's not dusty, and it just smelled clean even from the outside. My stay was very comfortable. The double queen was very spacious for 4 people, with plenty of space for all or luggage and even a rollaway bed if we needed. The toiletry products offered were of Bliss brand and smelled so good and refreshing. The hotel even had a lounge area with a pool table, the gym amenities were clean and new, and staff was very friendly and helpful. I hope this same high qual...

I recently had the pleasure of staying at the Aloft NOLA recently while in town for a wedding. I am VERY familiar with this brand/concept and was more than willing the stay here for a couple of nights. This location is about 3-4 blocks from the river and smack dab in the CBD. Lots of big buildings and very much in the city. Those unfamiliar with the Aloft brand, it's full service but not 4 star. It's like the baby W hotel. They have a bar with a limited food menu and they have grab and go food/drinks that you purchase at the front desk. They don't have bathtubs (i'm pretty sure) in any of the rooms and the rooms are pretty small but you get what you need. A bed, a bath and a TV mounted to...

We stayed 2 nights at aloft and had a smooth experience. The modern, funky decor isn't my first choice but we booked through hot wire and didn't know what we were getting. They had everything we were looking for in regards to room and location Rooms: was a little scared to find out some rooms didn't have windows, thankfully ours did. Comfortable and spacious rooms - ours had 2 queens, a desk, closet, TV, bench, and mini fridge. Bathroom was clean and loved the set up of a separate sink. Service: our shower head wasn't working and notified the hotel, which was then fixed promptly! Everyone working there was kind and friendly.
